description: This file defines the LoggerData interface, which outlines methods related to ECU logging data, including getters for ID, name, description, and data convertors, as well as selection management methods.

classes.name: LoggerData
classes.description: Interface defining methods for accessing and manipulating logger data related to ECU information, including conversion tools and selection state.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the logger data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logger data.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the logger data.

methods.name: getConvertors
methods.description: Returns an array of available EcuDataConvertors.

methods.name: selectConvertor
methods.description: Sets the specified convertor as the selected one.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether this logger data is currently selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection status of this logger data.
